title: TUF Metadata Container Schema
description: JSON Schema for TUF metadata files with signatures wrapper (root.json, targets.json, snapshot.json, timestamp.json)

signed.description: The signed portion of the metadata that is cryptographically signed.

signatures.description: List of cryptographic signatures over the 'signed' portion.

keyid.description: Identifier of the key used to generate this signature. Must match a key defined in the root metadata.

signature.description: The cryptographic signature over the canonical JSON representation of the 'signed' object, encoded as hexadecimal.
